title: STL to CAD Converter
summary: Convert a triangle mesh into CAD boundary geometry and inspect the result before downloading STEP or BREP. The reliable faceted method follows triangles and may produce a heavy model; experimental analytic methods try to make a more compact representation. Conversion does not recreate the original designer’s feature tree.
features: Upload an STL; the hosted route enforces a 32 MB limit.
Faceted, arcwise and hybrid strategies with different fidelity, size and robustness tradeoffs.
Analytic tolerance, decimation target, dihedral threshold, arc simplification and refinement.
Solid, Input mesh, Deviation, By type and Wireframe views.
Review closure, solid count, volume/deviation information and timings when available.
Export STEP, BREP and result archives for downstream CAD work.
workflows: Start with a small, closed STL whose scale you know. Keep the original unchanged.
Upload the STL, choose faceted as the baseline and inspect the triangle target. Decimation changes the mesh used for subsequent work, so document that choice.
Choose Convert and wait for the job result. Do not treat an output file alone as proof of a closed solid.
Read the validation result: closure, solid count, dimensions, volume and deviation. Inspect holes and thin features visually.
Save the baseline result, then try an analytic method with explicit tolerance values.
Inspect By type to see which surfaces were fitted and Deviation to locate differences. A compact file is not automatically the more accurate one.
Arcwise is experimental and may leave open edges or a sheet body. Decide whether repair in your CAD tool is acceptable rather than describing every output as watertight.
Download STEP for interchange or BREP for OpenCascade-compatible tools.
Import it into your CAD application and check units, solid status, hole geometry and overall dimensions.
Keep the source mesh and conversion settings with the output. A faceted solid is still faceted; converting the file format does not produce editable sketches and dimensions.
limits: A local static server cannot perform CAD conversion. The package needs the configured OpenCascade/Python environment or the NAS conversion service. No new full CAD integration test was performed for this documentation update.
